address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x3E`.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this SX1509 component.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

debounce_time.docs:
**int**: The debounce time is common to all IOs.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

key_columns.docs:
**int**: The number of keypad columns to use. This enables any number of the last 8 pins. So a value of 4 enables pins 8,9,10,11 to be used as the columns for the keypad matrix. This value must be between 1 and 8.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

key_rows.docs:
**int**: The number of keypad rows to use. This enables any number of the first 8 pins. So a value of 3 enables pins 0,1,2 to be used as the rows for the keypad matrix. This value must be between 2 and 8.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

keys.docs:
**string**: The keys present on the matrix, from top left to bottom right, row by row. Required for `key_collector`.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

on_key.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a key has been pressed. The key is in a variable called `x`.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

scan_time.docs:
**int**: Scan time per row (must be set above debounce time).

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

sleep_time.docs:
**int**: No key press within this time will set keypad engine to sleep.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

keypad.docs:
Add this to enable the keypad.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

col.docs:
**int**: The column number for this key on the keypad.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*

row.docs:
**int**: The row number for this key on the keypad.

*See also: [SX1509 16 channel I/O Expander with LED driver and keypad engine](https://esphome.io/components/sx1509#configuration-variables)*
